sourceNote: Every name, description and grade below is the official PlayStation listing as Exophase and PSNProfiles published it before this guide was written. Counts (42 Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone race locations, 9 activity types, 18 meditation spots, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garage properties, 500 choices) come from that same official listing. Where a guide gives a location or step, it says so only when the official description names it; anything else is labelled as our reading of the description, not a confirmed in-game fact — GTA VI launched 19 November 2026 and exact locations had not been verified in-game when this guide was written.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official PlayStation names, descriptions and grades)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (official PlayStation names, descriptions and grades)

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task to do. Work through the roadmap stages in order and it pops together with the last trophy you earn. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first story mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Nothing to prepare: follow the mission to its end. Story mission — finish it while it is available, and replay it from mission select if you miss it. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 — the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Play the story in order and do not skip side content that gates the next mission. Story chapter — complete it during the playthrough. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Chapters follow in order, so this comes naturally after Chapter 1 — keep pushing the story and it pops at the chapter's end. Story chapter — complete it during the playthrough. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the story opens up across Vice City, so keep the main missions moving and mop up the chapter's required strands as they appear. Story chapter — complete it during the playthrough. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Clear any remaining story strands the chapter asks for before its closing mission. Story chapter — complete it during the playthrough. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission — the gold trophy for seeing the story through to its end. Do the cleanup trophies you want before starting it only if you prefer one clean run; the story itself ends here. Story mission — finish it while it is available. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission flow. It is a named story mission, so it cannot be done early — play until it unlocks, then finish it. Story mission — finish it while it is available. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually need setup steps first, so finish whatever prep the game asks for, then run the heist itself to the end. Story mission — finish it while it is available. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it unlocks in the mission flow. Named story missions appear in order, so keep playing the story and take it when it is offered. Story mission — finish it while it is available. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The title points at a show or headline event in the story — play the mission through when it appears rather than leaving it for later. Story mission — finish it while it is available. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown — VCIA is Vice City International Airport, so expect this one at or around the airport. Finish it when the story offers it. Story mission — finish it while it is available. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a big set-piece operation — treat it as a late-story mission, bring your best gear, and finish it in one go. Story mission — finish it while it is available. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own checklist of story, activities, collectibles and side content, all finished. This is the last gold before the platinum: use the in-game stats page to find what is still missing, then work the roadmap backwards from the end. Nothing here is missable in itself, but the story trophies inside it are, so do those first. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like, as the game counts them. It adds up across the whole playthrough, so drive fast and take ramps whenever you see them; a stunt jump spot you can repeat makes the last stretch quick. The exact stunt list is not in the official description, so this guide claims no single best spot. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the official listing counts 9 types. Work down the activities list in this guide (shooting range, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, drone races and the rest) and tick each off as you sample it; you only need one try of each, not a win. Sources: official description and activity count, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count is from the official listing. Visit the shooting range early, learn one weapon's recoil at a time, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold clears; the range is repeatable, so no challenge is missable. Expect this to take a dedicated session or two. Sources: official description and challenge count, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — the count is from the official listing. Learn the drone's handling on the first course, then tour the map location by location; a win at each is what counts, not a time. Drone races are repeatable, so a lost race costs nothing but a retry. Sources: official description and location count, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Enter every race type you find (street, off-road and whatever else the map offers) and keep a fast car tuned for each; tick them off in this guide as you win them. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest against the character Cal. Take the challenge when it is offered, watch the line tension, and land the bigger catch; fishing challenges are repeatable, so a loss just means another try. The exact spot is not named in the official description, so this guide claims none. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game — any machine, start to end. Find an arcade, pick the shortest game on offer, and play it through; completing it is what counts, not a high score. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you meet the character in the open world — keep returning to Andy's marker until the strand ends with its final mission. Side content, not a story mission, so it stays available after the story. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand to its final mission. Meet Kenton in the open world, work through his missions in order, and take the final one when it appears. Side content that stays available after the story. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand to its final mission. The name points at a lone-rider, bike-flavoured strand — follow Billy's marker through his missions until the finale. Side content that stays available after the story. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the count is from the official description. Explore the map and take every stranger marker you find; each finished strand counts, and Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so you need three more. Strands stay available after the story. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand to its final mission. Work through Randy's missions as they appear on the map and take the finale when it unlocks. Side content that stays available after the story. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission. Follow Tyrone's marker through his missions in order until the strand's finale appears. Side content that stays available after the story. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — the count is from the official listing. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places; visit them while exploring and sit through the meditation at each one. No spot is missable, so tour them at your own pace after the story. Sources: official description and spot count, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a one-of-a-kind animal tied to Bret's strand. Find Bret, take his hunting work, and track the animal he names; a unique animal means there is one specific target, not any animal. The species and spot are not named in the official description, so this guide claims neither. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — find the cards scattered across Leonida and finish any three sets. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: pick up every card you pass while doing other stages, then sweep the remainder with a map at the end. No card is missable. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It — the in-game photo/sharing feature — at 100 locations across Leonida. The count is from the official listing. Make it a habit: WAiNK It at every landmark, vista and oddity you pass, and the total climbs while you do everything else. Sources: official description and location count, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's assorted mini-objectives across driving, combat, exploration and activities. They accumulate across the whole playthrough, so check the challenges list often and chase the easy ones first; the last few will need deliberate effort. The exact challenge list is not in the official description. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Do it in a fast car with a planned escape route — off-road or into the water beats trying to outrun helicopters in traffic. Your partner must be with you when the stars clear. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the streak breaks if the stars drop. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast one after another, and keep moving between them; do not stop to fight the police. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride each new vehicle type once and it counts. The count is from the official description. Hop into everything you see: cars, bikes, boats, planes and oddities all count, so vary your rides instead of sticking to one favourite. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus — the slow-down aiming mode. Pick a fight with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends; a gang hideout or a police standoff gives you the numbers. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport: get a plane airborne without following the booked departure. Steal a plane on the tarmac and take off; the description's joke is the point, so any runway departure that is not a scheduled flight should count. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank, so this trophy involves a Rhino — expect it in a mission or open-world moment built around one. The exact trigger is not named in the official description, so this guide claims no mission, step or spot for it; watch for a Rhino moment as you play. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean stealth job, not a smash-and-grab. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before any alarm or witness spots you; getting seen fails it, so restart if the alarm sounds. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — the count is from the official description. Bank vaults are the big heist-style robberies: plan an escape vehicle before you go in, and treat each vault as its own job rather than rushing all five at once. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — a nod to the classic blitz-style heist. Find a truck on its route, stop it, crack it open and get away clean with a fast car waiting. Armored trucks roam the map, so this is a matter of spotting one, not unlocking anything. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the count is from the official listing. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the map; the in-game map shades in as you visit places, so check it for blank patches and tour them. Pair this with the WAiNK It and meditation sweeps to save time. Sources: official description and area count, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — the count is from the official listing. Find each gang's turf and hit its operation; one per gang is enough, so keep a list of which gangs you have done. Gang territory is marked as you explore, and operations stay available. Sources: official description and gang count, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach and enjoy a cocktail with a view — the description names the place and the act, so this is a simple visit trophy. The exact venue is not named in the official description, so this guide claims none; look for a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front — the description is a nod to the classic showroom smash. Pick a showroom, build speed on the approach, and crash out through the glass. The exact showroom is not named in the official description, so this guide claims none. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game — the description names the venue, so head there and play. Follow-through means finishing the game rather than walking out mid-frame, so play it to the end. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — it points at a co-op moment with your partner that draws a crowd, but the exact trigger is not spelled out in the official list. Treat it as a partner moment to watch for as you play; this guide will not guess a location or step. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — the official listing tracks this trophy with a counter that runs to 500, so it is a long grind of decisions rather than one moment. Pick dialogue and story choices whenever they appear and the counter climbs. The exact list of counted choices is not in the official description, so this guide does not invent one. Sources: official description and count, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The wording points at succeeding on a second attempt after a first failure — retry something you just failed and finish it. Which activity counts is not spelled out in the official description, so try it on a mission or challenge you fail once, then pass on the retry. No location is claimed here because none is confirmed. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A trophy for witnessing something strange in Leonida — the description gives no place or trigger. Keep an eye out for odd events while exploring; this guide does not invent a location for it. If the community pins the trigger down after launch, the guide can be updated with a cited source. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: While driving, knock someone over with a melee weapon from the vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar, not a gun. Busy streets give you targets; one clean hit should do it. The exact weapon is not named in the official description. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — the amount is from the official description. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; pass them through your laundering contacts a little at a time and the total adds up across the playthrough. Do the big robberies first and this finishes itself. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the amount is from the official description. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play and the total climbs; it pairs naturally with the money trophies, so do not rush it early. Any shop spending counts. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties — the count is from the official listing. Garages go on sale as you progress and earn money; buy each one when it appears and keep the cash for the last ones, which are the pricey ones. None is missable. Sources: official description and property count, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the count is from the official description. Open the app on your phone, register each vehicle you own or find, and repeat until ten are listed; it pairs with the 100-vehicle discovery hunt. Sources: official description, Exophase / PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: On the Spot
